यौधेय १

YAUDHEYA I . A son of dharmaputra. mahābhārata. Ādi Parva, Chapter 95, Verse 76, states that this prince was born to dharmaputra by Devikādevī, daughter of govāsana, king of śibi land.

यौधेय २

YAUDHEYA II . A native of yaudheya country. mahābhārata, Sabhā Parva, Chapter 52, Verse 14, mentions, that the Yaudheyas had participated in Yudhiṣṭhira's rājasūya.

यौधेय ३

YAUDHEYA III . A king. According to matsya purāṇa, he was the son of prativindhya.
